fields.title: FocusBuddy
fields.subtitle: AI-Powered Task Decomposition & Executive Function Platform
fields.description: A cognitive-friendly productivity platform that helps students start and sustain momentum by deconstructing overwhelming to-do lists into bite-sized tasks, featuring intelligent single-task focus and integrated overwhelm recovery.

fields.title: HunianQita
fields.subtitle: Integrated & Verified Student Housing Search Platform

fields.title: PacilSync
